brief: Concept: an open, vendor-neutral standard (ADSF) whose core is a decision tree: accept, report, coerce, reject. Replaces the brief pages' generic navy/#2563eb look ("## Replaces"). Colours: white #ffffff (ground), ink #1a1d21, muted #59606b, rule #d9dce1, verdict-accept #1e6b47, verdict-report #1f5fad, verdict-coerce #8a5a00, verdict-reject #b42318. Type: "Public Sans" 400/700 (an open-source neutral face fits an open standard), "Source Code Pro" for code. Wordmark: "ADSF" in Public Sans 700; full name "Agent Design System Format". Cover pattern: a plus grid at one spacing step (precise, technical). Hero: "ADSF", the README one-sentence purpose, action "Read the format". Add a "Verdict" component: the four verdict states, each with a word (never colour alone).
